title: 第11章 无耻小贼
content_zh:
第11章无耻小贼
咯吱咯吱——
偏僻巷弄的小院里，依旧发出老旧木料不堪重负声响。
夜惊堂把床都快晃散架了，绞尽脑汁说着些他都觉得不要脸的骚话。
冷艳女侠依旧咬着下唇，泪汪汪的眸子盯着夜惊堂，就是不肯让外人听见不堪入耳的哼唧。
但随着污言秽语和动手动脚的双重摧残，她神色明显有了变化，脸色滚烫，呼吸很是不稳，额头浮现汗珠。
房间外，只能听到老床晃动和夜惊堂变着花样的骚话。
但好在夜惊堂演技到位，外面的捕快，最终还是放下戒心，又传来低声言语：
“长得人模狗样，嘴还挺花……‘后门别棍’啥意思？”
“抄后路的高深枪法，改天我让你见识一下。没啥听头，走吧走吧……”
踏踏——
两声翻越围墙的轻响后，院落里彻底安静下来。
密闭的房间中。
夜惊堂暗暗松了口气，偏头看向窗口，仔细侧耳倾听。
女子本来的冰冷脸色早已不在，变成了红润白皙透着水光，额头挂着汗珠，桃花美眸晶莹剔透。
整张脸颊有了血色，此时看起来更是美的惊心动魄，就好似受过摧残后的天宫玉女。
女子望着近在咫尺的俊朗侧脸，也不知是不是羞愤太久的缘故，这时候反而有点‘愤’不出来了，只感觉身上闷热，浑身上下的寒毒明明消退大半，却比刚才还使不上力气，小口喘息，眼底透着股精疲力尽的乏力感。
“你……啊~……”
待官差远去，女子刚想开口质问，就发现小贼的手动了下。
刚才是迫不得已逢场作戏，尚能解释，这次可是真的了！

而且外面没人听，女子心理防线没了，反倒是叫了一声，如泣如诉。
她做梦都没想到自己能发出这种‘可耻’的声音，连忙捂住嘴，眼底显出杀意，盯着上方的男子：
“你……”
夜惊堂转过头来，莫名其妙道：
“不能松开？那我重新握住？”
女人可不是软柿子，腰间软剑猝然出鞘，带出一抹寒芒。
夜惊堂反应极快，直接跳了出去，落在屋子里，握住刀柄：
“你想作甚？卸磨杀……过河拆桥？”
女人用软剑指着夜惊堂，眼神愤慨：
“无耻小贼……”
“女侠，咱俩谁是贼，你不清楚？”
夜惊堂看着梨花带雨，连生气都带着别样美感的脸颊：
“不这样，你怎么保证官兵不过来查看你的相貌伤势？明知道大难当头，还死倔不肯出声，你想急死我不成？”
女人双眸冰冷，却压不住眼底深处的仿徨无措：
“我知道你是逢场作戏，但你……你假戏真做！乘人之危……”
夜惊堂反问道：“我假戏真做你都不配合，逢场作戏你能配合好？你不是有闺女吗，不知道这戏怎么演？还是以前办事儿，也是头一偏、眼睛一闭，哼都不哼一声？”
女人面对这种‘污言秽语’，眼底羞怒更甚：
“你无耻！”
夜惊堂面露不满：“刚才你让我打掩护，我冒着风险帮你，等官差走了就骂我无耻？你要是临危不乱和我配合，我能碰你？”
“……”

女人瞪着夜惊堂，却也明白他说的是实话，银牙紧咬良久后，还是慢慢把软剑放了下来：
“看在你仗义相助的份儿上，我……我饶你这一次……”
夜惊堂这才满意，来到床铺近前：
“你说过教我武艺，教吧。”
女人抬起眼帘，满是怒色：
“你如此轻薄于我，我不计较，你还……”
“轻薄？你以为我乐意？我还没说你占我便宜。”
夜惊堂见对方想赖账，不高兴了，从床头拿起个小镜子，把两人的脸照在其中：
“你自己看看，咱俩谁好看？我犯得着为你把身家性命搭上？”
女人可能从没被贬低过美貌，听见这话明显觉得可笑至极，但转眼看向镜子里的倒影：
她刚才饱受摧残，发髻散乱、脸上挂着泪痕，又怒气冲冲，底子再好，此时也不及平日一半惊艳众生。
而旁边的小贼，剑眉星目器宇轩昂，从五官到气质都完美到无可挑剔……
在床底下躲了半天的鸟鸟，此时钻出来当裁判，站在两人之间左右打量半天后，用翅膀指向少妇：
“叽。”
意思还是小西瓜姐姐好看。
夜惊堂发现小蠢鸟拆台，顿时无语。
女人看懂了鸟鸟的意思，眼底显出闪过一抹淡淡的傲色，但这么一打岔，硬说这俊美小贼贪图她美色占便宜，也有点底气不足了，就冷声道：
“此事……此事我只当没发生过，你也不许声张，否则神仙都保不住你。”
夜惊堂见少妇不无理取闹了，把镜子丢去一边，整理衣袍。
女人转开了目光，用薄被把自己包好，悄悄整理被揉乱的衣襟，却猛然发现，腿根似乎被汗浸透了……

好像也不是汗……
夜惊堂看着少妇脸色涨红，眼神时而愤怒、时而无地自容，自然明白怎么会事儿，心中暗道：“逢场作戏都能做成这样，水做的不成……”
这话说出来，铁定不死不休，夜惊堂并未多言，扣好袍子询问道：
“现在没事儿了，你该把事情说清楚了吧？你是什么人？犯了什么事儿？”
少妇心思有点乱，悄声无息整理着衣衫，冷冰冰道：
“我叫骆凝，其他的，你知道没好处；此行进京，只为搭救一个江湖朋友。中午在黑衙探查，不慎触动陷阱，中了毒烟，为了躲开白无常追捕，才藏身此地……”
夜惊堂听见这话，稍显意外——黑衙捕快，通常两人一组出门办事儿，而最强六位总捕，被江湖人称为‘六煞’，以鬼差命名，分为：
铁臂无常、鬼影无常、金刚牛头、银勾马面、白发谛听、八臂地藏。
眼前这名为‘骆凝’的少妇，被白无常追，还能逃掉，说明武艺确实不容小觑。
夜惊堂大概听完过程后，又左右查看：
“你那丫头呢？”
“帮我引开追兵，应该很快会回来。你……你最好马上离开……”
“这是我家！”
夜惊堂示意床单被褥：“昨天才买的被褥，我全部家当。你招呼不打鸠占鹊巢，给我惹祸上身，我还没为难你，还想让我走？你是想赖账不教武艺？”
骆凝吃了这么大个亏，确实不太想教。
但江湖人一诺千金，她也不想欠这小贼人情，所以还是站起身，脚步滑开，抬起双掌：
“我说了只教一招，也只教这一次。你能
夜惊堂微微点头，神色专注，望着骆凝的动作。
骆凝抬起双掌，很有韵律的移动，时而抱月、时而平举，动作行云流水，来回演示半天后，往前一推，完事。
“你可学会了？”

夜惊堂满眼茫然：“你耍赖是吧？当我三岁小孩？这能叫功夫？”
骆凝面露怒色：“我已经教了你招式……”
“你教什么了？”
“叽。”
鸟鸟也是满眼茫然，还用翅膀晃了几下，示意——摇花手，这谁不会呀？
骆凝和夜惊堂对视，见他神情不似作假，怒色又慢慢收敛，疑惑询问：
“你以前没学过功夫？”
夜惊堂本想说自己学过功夫，但转念一想——义父教的全是假把式……那不就是没学过？
夜惊堂脸色柔和些许，认真请教：
“我确实没学过真功夫，你刚才确定在教招式？”
骆凝怪异瞄了夜惊堂几眼：“我看你根骨不俗，也有内劲傍身，还以为你学过功夫……没人教，你怎么练到这地步的？”
“每天负重跑三十里、举三百次石锁、五百个仰卧起坐……”
骆凝微微抬指，示意不用说了：
“你说的这些，当是有人指点，在给你打底子，正经武人不会这么练。”
“那我属于不正经的武人？”
“嗯。”
骆凝点头如鸟鸟，对这话相当赞同。
夜惊堂张了张嘴，没和骆女侠吵架，询问道：
“正常武人怎么习武？”
“所谓武功，武为招式、功为内劲，两者相辅相成。只有招式而无内劲，永远只是‘形似’；而有内劲无招式，则等于手下千军万马，却只会蛮力攻城，不通半点计谋。”

夜惊堂明白了意思：“我是有这感觉，那我现在算是只会横冲直撞的无脑将军？招式该怎么练？”
骆凝认真道：“招式是‘运气’的法门，而不是实战的套路，等你融会贯通、神形兼备，自然就明白了这一招该如何在实战中使用。同样是一记大巧不工的直拳，人家能撼动城墙，你却打不破门板，区别就在于背后的功夫不一样。”
夜惊堂似懂非，抬起双手缓慢移动：
“意思就是，这样慢慢演练，就是运气的门道；真打起来，只有最后这一推？”
“看来听懂了。”
骆凝颔首：“这一招，是《粘云十四手》第一式，讲究柔劲，能练到掌击胸腹，脏器尽碎而皮肤无损，便算是入门。寻常人练到这一步，至少三……三……”
少妇还没说完，就瞧见面前的黑衣年轻人，抬起双掌来回游移，动作和她方才分毫不差。
“你记性还真不错！”
骆凝略显讶异，继续指导：“仔细琢磨，为何有这么多动作，体会每个动作的分寸、力道、气血走向，认真感悟暗藏其中的运气法门……门……”
话语停了下来。
呼……呼……
密闭的小屋里，有隐隐微风拂面，吹起了少妇鬓角的发丝，眼神也慢慢从讶异转为了震惊……

Chapter 11 Shameless Thief
Creaking, creaking——
In the small courtyard in the remote alley, there is still the sound of old wood being overwhelmed.
The night terror hall shook the bed almost to pieces, and racked his brains to say some dirty words that he felt were shameless.
The cold and charming heroine was still biting her lower lip, staring at the Night Terror Hall with tearful eyes, just not willing to let outsiders hear her unbearable moans.
But with the double torture of obscene words and hands and feet, her expression changed obviously. Her face was hot, her breathing was very unsteady, and beads of sweat appeared on her forehead.
Outside the room, the only things that could be heard were the shaking of the old bed and the night terrors in the room.
But fortunately, the acting skills of Night Terror Hall were so good that the police officers outside finally let down their guard and whispered again:
"He looks like a human and has a pretty mouth... What does 'Don't stick at the back door' mean?"
"I'll show you the advanced marksmanship of taking the back route another day. It doesn't matter, let's go, let's go..."
Tread——
After two soft sounds over the wall, the courtyard became completely quiet.
In a closed room.
Ye Jingtang secretly breathed a sigh of relief, turned his head to look at the window, and listened carefully.
The woman's original cold complexion was long gone, and turned into rosy, fair and translucent, with beads of sweat hanging on her forehead, and her beautiful peach blossom eyes were crystal clear.
The whole cheek was filled with blood, and now she looked even more breathtakingly beautiful, just like a beautiful girl from the Heavenly Palace who had been tortured.
The woman looked at the handsome side face close at hand, and she didn't know if it was because she had been embarrassed and angry for too long. At this time, she was a little bit "angry". She only felt hot and stuffy in her body. Most of the cold poison in her body had obviously subsided, but she was no longer as strong as before. She gasped for breath, and there was a sense of exhaustion in her eyes.
"You...ah~..."
After the officer left, the woman was about to ask a question when she noticed the little thief's hand moved.
Just now I had no choice but to act on the occasion, I can still explain it, but this time it is true!
And no one outside listened. The woman's psychological defense was gone, and instead she screamed, sobbing.
She never dreamed that she could make such a 'shameful' sound. She quickly covered her mouth, with murderous intent in her eyes, staring at the man above:
"You..."
Ye Jingtang turned around and said inexplicably:
"Can't let go? Then I can hold it again?"
Women are not soft persimmons. The soft sword at the waist was suddenly unsheathed, giving off a cold light.
Ye Jingtang reacted very quickly, jumped out directly, landed in the house, and held the handle of the knife:
"What do you want to do? Kill people and kill people...cross rivers and burn bridges?"
The woman pointed her soft sword at Ye Jingtang, her eyes filled with indignation:
"Shameless little thief..."
"Xia Xia, you don't know which one of us is the thief?"
Ye Jingtang looked at the pear blossoms and the rain, even when he was angry, his cheeks had a different kind of beauty:
"Otherwise, how can you guarantee that the officers and soldiers will not come to check your appearance and injuries? You know that you are in serious danger, but you are still stubborn and refuse to speak out. Do you want to worry me to death?"
The woman's eyes were cold, but she couldn't suppress the hesitation deep in her eyes:
"I know you're just acting on occasion, but you... you're really acting like you're pretending! Taking advantage of others' danger..."
Ye Jingtang asked back: "You won't cooperate even if I'm pretending to be real. How can you cooperate well when I'm just putting on a show? Don't you have a daughter, and you don't know how to act in this show? Or when you were doing things in the past, you would turn your head to one side, close your eyes, and not even make a sound?"
When the woman faced this kind of 'foul words', her eyes became even more ashamed and angry:
"You are shameless!"
Ye Jingtang showed dissatisfaction: "You asked me to cover up just now, and I risked my life to help you, and then you scolded me for being shameless after the official left? If you cooperate with me in times of danger, can I touch you?"
"..."
The woman stared at Ye Jingtang, but she also understood that he was telling the truth. After clenching her silver teeth for a long time, she slowly put down the soft sword:
"For the sake of your help, I...I will spare you this time..."
Only then was Ye Jingtang satisfied, and came to the bed:
"You said you would teach me martial arts, teach me."
The woman raised her eyes, full of angerColor:
"You are so frivolous to me, I don't care, but you still..."
"Frivolous? Do you think I'm happy with it? I haven't said you took advantage of me yet."
Ye Jingtang was unhappy when he saw that the other party wanted to default on his debt. He picked up a small mirror from the bedside and reflected their faces in it:
"See for yourself, which one of us is better looking? Do I have to risk my life and fortune for you?"
The woman may have never been belittled for her beauty. She obviously felt ridiculous hearing these words, but then she looked at her reflection in the mirror:
She had been tortured just now, her hair was messy, her face was stained with tears, and she was angry. No matter how good her foundation was, she was not half as stunning as usual at this moment.
As for the little thief next to him, he has sword-shaped eyebrows, starry eyes, and majestic weapons. From his facial features to his temperament, he is impeccable...
Birdie, who had been hiding under the bed for a long time, came out to act as a referee. He stood between the two and looked around for a long time, then pointed at the young woman with his wings:
"Ji."
I mean, Little Watermelon Sister is pretty.
Night Terror Hall found out that the little stupid bird was causing trouble and was immediately speechless.
The woman understood what Niao Niao meant, and there was a hint of pride in her eyes. However, after such an interruption, she insisted that this handsome little thief was taking advantage of her beauty, and she felt a little lacking in confidence, so she said coldly:
"This matter... I will just pretend that this matter never happened, and you are not allowed to say anything about it, otherwise even the gods will not be able to protect you."
Seeing that the young woman was not unreasonable, Ye Tingtang threw the mirror aside and straightened her clothes.
The woman turned away her eyes, wrapped herself in a thin quilt, and quietly straightened the messed up clothes, but suddenly discovered that the roots of her legs seemed to be soaked with sweat...
It doesn’t seem like sweat…
Ye Jingtang looked at the young woman's face turning red, her eyes sometimes angry and sometimes ashamed. Naturally, she understood what was going on, and thought to herself: "You can do this just for fun, but water can't do it..."
After saying this, he was determined to fight to the death. Ye Jingtang didn't say much, buttoned up his robe and asked:
"It's okay now. It's time for you to explain things clearly, right? Who are you? What have you committed?"
The young woman was a little confused. She straightened her clothes quietly and said coldly:
"My name is Luo Ning. You know that there is no good in anything else. I came to Beijing this time just to rescue a friend from the Jianghu. I was exploring the black office at noon, accidentally triggered a trap, and was poisoned by poisonous smoke. In order to avoid Bai Wuchang's pursuit, I hid here..."
Ye Jingtang was a little surprised when he heard this - the black police officers usually go out in pairs to do errands, and the six strongest chief arresters are called the "Six Evils" by people in the world, named after ghosts, and they are divided into:
The iron arm is impermanent, the ghost shadow is impermanent, the vajra bull head, the silver hooked horse face, the white-haired listener, and the eight-armed Ksitigarbha.
The young woman named 'Luo Ning' in front of her was able to escape while being chased by Bai Wuchang, which showed that her martial arts skills should not be underestimated.
After Ye Jingtang probably finished listening to the process, he looked around:
"Where's your girl?"
"Help me lure away the pursuers. They should be back soon. You...you'd better leave right away..."
"This is my home!"
Ye Jingtang gestured to the sheets and quilts: "The quilts I just bought yesterday are all my belongings. You're asking me to occupy the magpie's nest without hitting the dove, and you're getting me into trouble. I haven't made things difficult for you yet, and you still want me to leave? Do you want to default on your debt and not teach martial arts?"
Luo Ning suffered such a big loss and really didn't want to teach.
But the people in the world were promising a lot of money, and she didn’t want to owe this little thief any favors, so she stood up, stepped away, and raised her palms:
"I said I would only teach one move, and I would only teach it this time. Can you
Ye Jingtang nodded slightly, looking attentively at Luo Ning's movements.
Luo Ning raised her palms and moved them rhythmically, sometimes hugging the moon, sometimes raising them flat. Her movements were smooth and flowing. After demonstrating back and forth for a long time, she pushed forward and was done.
"Have you learned it? "
Ye Jingtang's eyes were filled with confusion: "You're cheating, right? When I'm a three-year-old? Can this be called Kung Fu? "
Luo Ning's face showed anger: "I have already taught you the moves..."
"What did you teach? "
"Ji. "
The birds were also blank-eyed and even used their wings toHe shook his arms a few times and signaled - wave his hand, who can't do this?
Luo Ning and Ye Jingtang looked at each other, and seeing that his expression didn't seem to be fake, her anger slowly faded away, and she asked doubtfully:
"Have you never learned kung fu before?"
Ye Jingtang wanted to say that he had learned kung fu, but then he thought about it - all his adoptive father taught him were fake moves... Doesn't that mean he has never learned it?
Ye Jingtang's face softened a little, and he asked for advice seriously:
"It is true that I have never learned real Kung Fu. Are you sure you were teaching moves just now?"
Luo Ning glanced at Ye Jingtang strangely: "I see that you have good bones and internal strength. I thought you had learned kung fu... No one taught you, how did you get to this point?"
"Run thirty miles with weights every day, lift stone locks three hundred times, and do five hundred sit-ups every day..."
Luo Ning raised her finger slightly, indicating that there was no need to say more:
"Those things you said are meant to be given by someone to give you some guidance. A serious martial artist would not practice like this."
"Then I am an unscrupulous warrior?"
"Yeah."
Luo Ning nodded like a bird, quite agreeing with this statement.
Ye Jingtang opened her mouth and asked without arguing with Luo Nuxia:
"How does a normal martial artist practice martial arts?"
"The so-called martial arts, martial arts are moves, and gong is inner strength. The two complement each other. Only moves but no inner strength will always be "similar"; and having inner strength but no moves means that you have thousands of troops, but you can only attack the city with brute force, without any strategy."
Ye Jingtang understood the meaning: "I feel this way, so now I am a brainless general who only knows how to run rampant? How should I practice my moves?"
Luo Ning said seriously: "The moves are a method of 'luck', not actual combat routines. Once you have mastered it and mastered it both spiritually and physically, you will naturally understand how to use this move in actual combat. It is also a straight punch that is clever but not very skillful. Others can shake the city wall, but you cannot break the door panel. The difference lies in the Kung Fu behind it."
Ye Jingtang seemed to understand, raised his hands and moved slowly:
"It means that practicing slowly like this is the key to luck; when it comes to a real fight, the only thing you can do is the last push?"
"It seems I understand."
Luo Ning nodded: "This move is the first move in the "Fourteen Sticky Cloud Hands". It emphasizes softness and strength. If you can practice it to the point where the palm hits the chest and abdomen, all the organs are broken but the skin is not damaged, it is considered a beginner. For ordinary people, it takes at least three...three..."
Before the young woman finished speaking, she looked at the young man in black in front of her. He raised his palms and moved them back and forth. His movements were exactly the same as hers just now.
"You have a really good memory!"
Luo Ning was slightly surprised and continued to guide: "Think carefully about why there are so many movements, understand the proportion, strength, and direction of Qi and blood in each movement, and seriously understand the hidden luck method...door..."
The words stopped.
Huh...huh...
In the airtight cabin, there was a faint breeze blowing on her face, blowing the hair on the young woman's temples, and her eyes slowly changed from surprise to shock...
